Discuss how this process may look for different organizations and for different o building types - 3:55 – 4:00 Closing Key resources o Contact information o Breakout Activity (2:20-3:20)—Each group lead by building energy subject matter expert Timing and instructions for activity • 5 minutes: Read the scenario from the handout. Questions may come up but try to focus participants on the steps. • 10 minutes: Set goals for the building. Teams should write these down on the Overview Table. There are examples on the handout. The group may not come to consensus on what their goals are as they are coming from different organizations, so it is okay to set multiple goals to accommodate a range of priorities. • 20 minutes: Teams should pick one card from each color/category. Enter the selected cards on the Energy Savings Table and Overview Table to come up with total EUI and payback and see if it meets the original goals. • 25 minutes: Encourage teams to reevaluate payback and energy use and determine if another set of cards might be better suited to meet their goal(s). They can rework the numbers and reevaluate as time permits.
